title: Bereshit Rabbah — Hebrew Wikisource, chapters 1–100
attribution: Bereshit Rabbah, chapters 1–100, Hebrew Wikisource contributors. Each source passage, pinned revision, and contributor history, including replacement source pages, is listed in source-manifest.json. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Removed navigation, editing controls, style, scripts, an external-links section, a separate Rashi section and dynamically transcluded commentary; joined source paragraphs as one passage per page and escaped markup. Source passage numbering is retained; redirect aliases and one unlisted empty page were excluded and a source omission notice retained. The mismatched source pages 51:1 and 57:1 were withheld; Seven empty pages in chapters 61–62 and eleven empty pages in chapters 66–68 remain empty. A duplicate explicitly marked chapter 52:1 was removed from the end of 51:11; it remains at 52:1. No OCR or new translation was performed by Amudi. The current source text and revision summaries were checked for OCR notices, but all prior revision text was not audited. Adaptations remain under CC BY-SA 4.0. Chapters 70:3, 70:5 and 70:10 use same-text source pages mislabelled as chapter 71; the erroneous source text at 71:1, 71:3, 71:5 and 71:10 is withheld. Empty pages remain empty. For chapters 73–80, navigation and a separately transcluded Matnot Kehunah commentary section were removed; fourteen empty source pages remain empty. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 81–88, navigation was removed and two empty source pages remain empty. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 89–96, navigation and page edit controls were removed; source explanatory glosses were retained as part of the credited source edition. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi. For chapters 97–100, navigation and page edit controls were removed. At chapter 99 the source combines two passages and subsequent numbering differs from the comparison edition. No OCR or translation was performed by Amudi.
coverageStatus: 1036 source passage slots in chapters 1–100. Some Hebrew source pages are empty or mislabelled; see missingOriginalPassages and source-manifest.json. Three chapter 70 passages were recovered from separately credited mislabelled source pages. The source contains all 100 numbered chapters; some earlier passage slots are unavailable, and edition boundaries differ at chapter 99.
